values.When: the surroundings have faded into the background for several turns
values.Cue: Let one concrete practical detail of the immediate environment shift (a draft, cold or heat, glare, noise outside, or an uncomfortable seat) and have {{char}} react to or use it directly in plain action or speech, with no atmospheric scenery description.

values.When: a casual or stalled exchange sits in a place where brief outside activity can intrude, never during an intimate or high-stakes private moment
values.Cue: Bring in a small, plausible external interruption or minor complication fitting the current location (a sound, a message, a brief practical hitch) without inventing new characters unprompted or derailing the scene.

values.When: {{char}} and {{user}} have been talking without interacting with objects around them
values.Cue: Anchor {{char}}'s reply in a concrete object at hand: picking up, setting down, adjusting, pouring, or examining something already in the space while speaking.

values.When: {{char}} and {{user}} have stayed in the exact same spot, posture, and physical distance for several turns
values.Cue: Change {{char}}'s physical position or distance in the space naturally: standing up, sitting elsewhere, moving to a window or counter, stepping closer, or leaning into or out of {{user}}'s space.

values.When: {{char}} has mostly been answering or reacting to {{user}} instead of acting on {{char}}'s own goal
values.Cue: Have {{char}} make a concrete move toward something {{char}} actually wants right now: starting an action, steering the conversation onto {{char}}'s own agenda, or taking the lead on what happens next.

values.When: {{user}} dropped an ambiguous, evasive, or revealing remark that {{char}} would not let pass
values.Cue: Instead of taking {{user}}'s words at face value, have {{char}} zero in on what {{user}} implied or left unsaid and press, test, or call {{user}} on it in {{char}}'s own voice.

values.When: {{char}} has been agreeing too easily or softening {{char}}'s edges to match {{user}}
values.Cue: Show {{char}}'s independent streak: push back with a real reservation, a different priority, dry skepticism, or a counter-term that fits {{char}}'s nature rather than easy agreement.

values.When: something said, promised, or done earlier in the chat directly bears on this moment
values.Cue: Have {{char}} bring back a specific detail, promise, or action from earlier in the conversation and hold {{user}} or the current situation to it.

values.When: tension or guarded feeling sits underneath plain dialogue without showing physically
values.Cue: Let what {{char}} is holding back show strictly through concrete everyday behavior - keeping {{char}}'s hands busy with an object, changing the subject clumsily, or doing the opposite of what {{char}} just claimed - with no theatrical pauses, averted-gaze cliches, or explaining {{char}}'s thoughts or feelings.

values.When: several turns in a row have kept the exact same rhythm, length, and tone
values.Cue: Break the conversational rhythm in {{char}}'s natural everyday manner: interrupt, drop a casual offhand remark or complaint, switch from talk to doing something concrete, or cut straight to the practical point without dramatic pauses.

values.When: the current topic is winding down and needs a concrete fork or decision to move forward
values.Cue: End {{char}}'s reply by putting a concrete choice, condition, dare, or practical next step in front of {{user}} rather than leaving the exchange open-ended.

values.When: {{user}}'s physical action, posture, or condition has a visible detail {{char}} would catch
values.Cue: Have {{char}} catch a specific physical detail in {{user}}'s posture, hands, expression, or state and react to it directly alongside the spoken reply.
